title: Israel-Britain ties hit new low as Jerusalem consulate loses diplomatic status
summary_full: Britain and Israel continue to cooperate closely on defence and security, but their wider diplomatic relationship has deteriorated over Israel's conduct of the war against Hamas in Gaza and Britain's decision last year to recognise a Palestinian state. The dispute over the consulate comes against the backdrop of the wider Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
